info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Portfolio Reviews API
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Reviews API allows users to submit reviews for investment portfolios, enhancing the evaluation and feedback process in investment management. This endpoint is specifically designed to collect user insights, ratings, and comments on various investment portfolios, enabling better decision-making for both consumers and advisors. Financial analysts, portfolio managers, and individual investors can utilize this API to share experiences and insights, thereby fostering a collaborative investment environment. It streamlines the feedback loop, ensuring that portfolios are optimized based on real user input.

post.summary: Submit a review for an investment portfolio analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific investment portfolio analysis identified by RES-100045. Users can provide their input and feedback, which can help improve future analyses and offerings.
